title: When the BSD Real Period Remembers Elliptic Curves over $\mathbb{Q}$
summary: We study the extent to which the invariants appearing in the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture remember the elliptic curve, and we give several affirmative answers to this question. For example, the real period $Ω_E =\frac{Γ(1/4)^2}{2\sqrtπ\,17^{1/4}}$ and the Tate--Shafarevich group $ \Sha(E/\mathbb{Q})\cong \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ remember the elliptic curve $E: y^2=x^3+17x$.
